violations.description: Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Ventilation hood system was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. The hood over the frills on the back side needs to be cleaned.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. The floor in the back of cooler 2 needs to be cleaned.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Shelves in cooler 3 by the glass doors need to be cleaned.--Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Gasket on the pizza cooler needs to be cleaned. The gasket and inside of the old cooler being used as spare table across from the flat grill needs to be cleaned.
Clean dry location, protected (1 pt deducted)
